system.description:
OPDQ. Opposed Strange Check against everyone within Near Range (15 ft), allies included. Anyone who doesn't match or beat your roll hallucinates: they can't attack you and may only take Interact or Move Actions. Each may make a CR 2 Strange Check at the start of its Combat Turn to break free. The effect ends if you take damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.65

automation.label: Opposed vs everyone within 15 ft
automation.onSuccess: Everyone within 15 ft who rolled fewer Strange successes than you hallucinates.
automation.onFail: Targets who matched or beat your roll are unaffected.

automation.note: Everyone within 15 ft (friend or foe) rolls Strange against your result. Hallucinating creatures can't attack you and may only Interact or Move; each rolls Strange CR 2 at the start of its Combat Turn to break free. All of it ends as soon as you take damage.
